from executor.agent_review import review_last
from executor.scheduler_agent import clear_schedules, add_schedule, list_schedules, run_due_schedules
from executor.intent import detect_intent
from executor.tools import run_tool

print("---- REVIEW ----")
print(review_last())

print("---- SCHEDULER ----")
clear_schedules()
print(add_schedule("κάθε 30 λεπτά battery guard"))
print(add_schedule("κάθε ώρα repair system"))
print(add_schedule("κάθε μέρα στις 09:00 daily brief"))
print(list_schedules())

tasks = list_schedules()
tasks[0]["next_run"] = time.time() - 1
json.dump(tasks, open("data/scheduled_tasks.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print(run_due_schedules())

print("---- AUTONOMY COMMANDS ----")
for cmd in ["autonomy status", "autonomy start", "autonomy status", "autonomy stop", "autonomy status"]:
    intent = detect_intent(cmd)
    print(cmd, "=>", intent, "=>", run_tool(intent, {"command": cmd}))

print("OK")
